findings.evidence: Grep of `theorem lineCoord` in Trivialization.lean: lines 717, 721, 725, 730 and 733 cover `lineCoord`; line 847 (`_symm_apply`) is the only lemma about `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne`.
findings.fix: Add `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne_apply_smul`, `@[simp] lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne_self`, `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne_smul_self` and `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne_eq_iff`, each proved from `_symm_apply` as in lines 721-735. Also add `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne 𝕜 𝕜 (finrank_self 𝕜) hv = lineCoord 𝕜 hv`, or redefine `lineCoord` as this special case.
findings.issue: `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne` only has `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne_symm_apply`. The `lineCoord` it generalises also has `lineCoord_apply_smul`, `@[simp] lineCoord_self`, `lineCoord_smul_self` and `lineCoord_eq_iff`. There is also no lemma relating the two definitions when `F = 𝕜`, so they are two parallel APIs for the same object.

findings.evidence: The only lemmas in Line.lean are `tensorEquivOfNeZero_apply` and `continuous_tensorEquivOfNeZero`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] tensorEquivOfNeZero_symm_apply_tmul : (tensorEquivOfNeZero F hG hs x).symm (v ⊗ₜ s x) = v`, or more generally `(tensorEquivOfNeZero F hG hs x).symm (v ⊗ₜ w) = lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne 𝕜 G hG (hs x) w • v`.
findings.issue: `tensorEquivOfNeZero` has only the forward lemma `tensorEquivOfNeZero_apply`. Nothing describes its inverse, which divides by `s x`, so evaluating the inverse requires unfolding the definition.

summary: The surface is minimal, bodies are hidden and there is no compatibility layer or free data, but neither new equivalence has its full characteristic API: `lineCoordOfFinrankEqOne` lacks its forward lemmas and `tensorEquivOfNeZero` lacks an inverse lemma.
